event_confirmation: Company press release 'Stoke Therapeutics to Host Webcast and Conference Call to Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Business and Financial Updates', dated 2026-10-22, names company contacts and sets the call for Thursday 2026-10-29 at 4:30 p.m. ET (amc). It is republished verbatim by two aggregators: https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/STOK/stoke-therapeutics-webcast-conference-call-q3-2026 and https://www.quantisnow.com/earnings/STOK. The company IR site returned 403 to fetch, so the original page was not read directly; the release text, company contacts and the 4:30 p.m. ET slot match the prior three quarters (Q2 call 2026-08-03 4:30 p.m. ET, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001623526/000119312526330537/stok-20260803.htm).
conviction_note: Clinical-stage biotech whose quarter itself does not move the stock; the one line that can (the guided H2 2026 pre-NDA meeting with FDA, if the outcome is disclosed in this release) has no sign I can source, and the positioning items (17.6% of float short and covering, BVF crossing 5% in September, versus the ex-CEO's ~$38m Form 144 sale from 2026-10-21) roughly offset, so p_up 50 on an abs move of 8% (median of 7 prior reactions 7.56%, nudged up because a regulatory update is plausibly in this release and the short is crowded); impact_sum +0.2 is the small sum of offsetting findings, consistent with the scaled 0.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus about -$0.91 (TipRanks -0.92 from 10 analysts, https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/STOK/earnings; Benzinga -0.91, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/STOK/earnings-forecasts) but MarketBeat's analyst table averages -$0.77 (range -0.81 to -0.72) and its header shows -0.93 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/STOK/earnings/), so the EPS bar is disputed; revenue consensus $8.2M (Benzinga and MarketBeat agree). print_vs_bar_pct is on revenue: Q2 collaboration revenue was $9.3M against a $4.9M estimate and Q1 was $6.3M (6M $15.6M less Q2 $9.3M), so ~5% over $8.2M is an inference, not a sourced number. The stock does not trade on EPS or revenue; it trades on zorevunersen regulatory/timeline news. No company financial guidance exists beyond runway into early 2028.
positioning_check: Short interest 10,256,830 shares, 17.58% of float, 12.3 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement (FINRA, published 2026-10-26), down 10.85% from 11,505,410 on 2026-09-30 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/STOK/short-interest/). Stock $26.44, -31% from 52w high, +1.65% over 20 days, ~-15% since $31.20 on 2026-08-31.

findings.finding: Stoke guided a pre-NDA meeting with FDA in H2 2026 to align on data package, timing and statistical analysis plan, with a rolling NDA to start Q1 2027 (Q2 release, 2026-08-03); no announcement since says the meeting has occurred, so this Q3 release/call (2026-10-29, ~2 months before H2 ends) is the likeliest place an outcome or a date is disclosed. Outcome unknown, so sized at 0 with a wide two-sided range; the last FDA-interaction update (Jan 2026: FDA 'requested additional information', no immediate program change) printed -10.44%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-12 (8-K with FDA multidisciplinary meeting update, FDA asked for more information): -10.44% per baseline. 2026-08-03 Q2 print with enrollment complete and readout moved from mid-2027 to Q3 2027: +7.14% as tagged (+2.43% if bmo).
findings.why_not_priced: The outcome is not public: no 8-K, release or conference remark since 2026-08-03 reports the meeting (searches of Stoke news, EDGAR 8-K list through 2026-09-25 show only a board change). If the market had a view it would show in a usable option chain; the chain is not two-sided and the stock sits mid-range with a flat 20-day run-up. Sign genuinely unknown, hence 0.
findings.independence: Jan 2026 FDA-interaction precedent: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1623526/000119312526009781/d36198dex991.htm. Same Q2 document as finding on financing (different line).

findings.finding: Former CEO and director Edward Kaye, who resigned from the board effective 2026-09-23, filed a Form 144 on 2026-10-21 to sell 1,496,042 shares (aggregate $38.4M at $25.68, ~2.3% of 64.5M shares outstanding, ~1.3x the 20-day average daily volume of 1.11M) via cashless option exercise, no 10b5-1 plan indicated; this supply may still be working through the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a large affiliate sale into a STOK print found. Stock was +0.1% on the day the call notice appeared (BiopharmaWatch baseline $25.68 on 2026-10-21) and is +3% since to $26.44, so the sale has not visibly pressed the price.
findings.why_not_priced: Form 144s are filed but rarely reported by wires; if the market were leaning on it the stock would be weak since 10-21, and it has risen ~3%. Whether the shares have already been sold is unknown (no Form 4 needed after he left the board).
findings.independence: Board resignation 8-K (Item 5.02, 'not the result of any disagreement'): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1623526/000119312526402820/d136438d8k.htm; Kaye was CEO 2017-March 2025: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250318206755/en/Stoke-Therapeutics-Announces-CEO-Transition

findings.finding: Biotechnology Value Fund (BVF Partners / Mark Lampert), a specialist biotech holder, filed a new Schedule 13G on 2026-09-30 reporting 3,608,968 shares (5.6%) with an event date of 2026-09-23, i.e. it crossed 5% while the stock fell from $31.20 (Aug 31) to ~$25.50 (late Sep).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none on record for this name
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a month; small. It signals a specialist buyer underneath the September drawdown, which would show as support near $25-26 (the stock has held that level since late September).
findings.independence: Short interest falling 10.9% in early October (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/STOK/short-interest/) points the same way on flows.

findings.finding: Short interest is crowded at 10.26M shares, 17.58% of float, 12.3 days to cover (2026-10-15 settlement), and was already being covered (-10.9% versus 2026-09-30); any reassuring regulatory or timeline language in the release meets a short book that needs 12 days of volume to exit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-08-12 print +24.98% (largest in baseline) shows the upside tail this name can carry; downside prints were -9.94% and -10.44%.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public; what is not priced is the asymmetry it adds to an unknown regulatory update. A priced squeeze would show as a run-up into the print; 20-day run-up is +1.65%.
findings.independence: Curved Trading 13.0M / 12.7 DTC at 2026-08-14 (snippet only, page 403): https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/stok/short-interest/

findings.finding: Partner Biogen's Q3 2026 release on 2026-10-28, the day before Stoke reports, reiterates the zorevunersen Phase 3 EMPEROR readout in Q3 2027, so the counterparty that co-funds the program shows no timeline slip; Stoke's own guide (Q3 2027 readout, rolling NDA Q1-H2 2027) is therefore less likely to move in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The previous timeline change (readout mid-2027 to Q3 2027, disclosed with Q2) coincided with +7.14% as tagged / +2.43% if bmo; Jan 2026 FDA-delay news -10.44%.
findings.why_not_priced: Public a day before; it is a non-event that removes one downside path rather than adds news, so it is worth little. If the market had feared a slip the stock would have weakened into the print; it is +2.9% over 5 days.
findings.independence: Biogen 10-Q for Q3 2026 notes the Sept 2026 zorevunersen data presentation: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000875045/000087504526000096/biib-20260930.htm

findings.finding: Competitor Encoded Therapeutics presented updated ETX101 (one-time gene therapy, SCN1A Dravet) data on 2026-09-09: ~76% (DL3, n=5) and ~60% (DL4, n=9) median seizure reductions through week 52, ~79-89% at month 12 in the 52-week subsets, no treatment-related SAEs, pivotal ENDEAVOR Part 2 dosing; this landed in the month STOK fell ~18%, and the call is the first place management answers on competitive positioning.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No company print has turned on competitor data; STOK fell from $31.20 (Aug 31) to ~$25.50 (Sep 28), cause not stated in any source found.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the September drawdown is the visible sign it was. Filed small as a proxy for call-time questioning, not as new information.
findings.independence: Price path Aug 31 $31.20 (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/STOK/stoke-biogen-eec-zorevunersen-dravet-syndrome) to $25.50 Sep 28 (https://bullstory.io/en/stocks/stok/forecast) is consistent but not attributed.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-03 Stoke put a new $200M ATM (Cantor) on its S-3ASR after selling ~2.1M shares for $65.7M net to a single investor after June 30; the Q3 10-Q filed with this print will show how much of the new ATM was used in Q3 and post-quarter. The money funds launch readiness and Phase 3 through potential US commercialization in early 2028 ($420M pro forma cash; R&D $49.5M and SG&A $25.3M in Q2, up 91% and 65% y/y on launch preparation), so the use is corroborated and the sign is near zero; dilution adds shares to the EPS denominator.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 print disclosing the $65.7M post-quarter sale and new ATM: +7.14% as tagged (+2.43% if bmo); financing was not sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 ATM usage is not yet disclosed; a large draw at $25-31 would be visible only in the 10-Q. The market knows the shelf exists, so only the size is new.
findings.independence: Q2 release cash and spend lines: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001623526/000119312526330537/stok-ex99_1.htm (shares the program with finding 1's source document, different line).

findings.finding: The 4-year OLE data released 2026-09-01 (presented at EEC 2026-09-05/09) disclosed elevated CSF protein lab values in ~94% of zorevunersen patients, 59% classified as treatment-emergent adverse events, with no serious clinical manifestations and no hydrocephalus; this is the safety line most likely to feature in the pre-NDA dialogue and in call questions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Release day -1% (BiopharmaWatch, baseline $31.20 2026-08-31); CSF protein has been a known STOK concern since 2023 (stock -34% then on early data with this safety note).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public for two months and a long-known signal. Kept small because it bears on how FDA frames the data package, which is the line finding 1 resolves.
findings.independence: 2023 reaction to the same CSF-protein concern: https://www.fool.com/investing/2023/07/25/why-shares-of-stoke-therapeutics-plummeted-tuesday/

baseline_tension: No usable skew and a flat 20-day run-up, so there is no market direction to agree or disagree with; the heavy put open interest (P/C 14.8) and 17.6% short interest lean bearish, while BVF buying and short covering lean the other way, and my findings net to about zero.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short, 17.6% of float): Kaye Form 144 supply finding shrunk from -0.5 to -0.4.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): ATM use is corroborated by launch-readiness spend and runway to early-2028 launch, so the financing finding moved from -0.3 to -0.1.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): ETX101 competitor finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2 as a priced proxy.
Lesson 6 (bar): EPS bar disputed (-0.91 vs -0.77 vs -0.93), so print_vs_bar is stated on revenue as inference and no finding is sized on the EPS line; abs_move_pct and p_up unchanged (8.0, 50).
